entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 376, 511, 379, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the FIR, the petitioner is said to have tried to outrage the modesty of the informant.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is quite innocent and has committed no offence.
He has been falsely implicated in this case.
No such occurrence, in the manner as alleged, has ever taken place.
It is further submitted that the husband of the informant had borrowed money from the petitioner and when petitioner demanded his money back, he was implicated in this case.

It is further Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.61528 of 2024(2)
dt.05-10-2024 submitted that the parties have compromised the matter and this statement is not denied by the learned counsel for the informant.
5. Learned APP for the State as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

sentences.text:
Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his/her arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/Successor Court in connection with Naubatpur P.S. Case No.17 of 2023,
subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) shikha/-
